coupling: The case-equivalence commit retains non-ASCII case-insensitive ranges from a single-character run and, on a revisit, copies the saved range count into scratch space sized for the current alternatives. The lookbehind commit adds an order-preserving normalization pass before its existing pass. The first pass folds three alternatives into one; the second allocates one CharacterRange and copies three. With either edit removed, the same probe has no overflowing revisit.
